summary: Iteration 7 — Full-stack validation of NEW features (bulk sync/reread, options validator, CSV exports, webhook channel) + regression on auth, SSH-encryption round-trip and per-server sync guard. Backend: 21/21 new iteration-7 tests PASS + 45/45 prior regression (iter4 auth + iter6 hardening) PASS = 66/66 (100%). Frontend: all 6 testable flows verified end-to-end via Playwright on the live preview URL — admin login, SYNC ALL & REREAD ALL buttons present and functional (toast confirmed 'lmreread issued to 6 server(s)'), Expiry CSV download triggers with correct filename, Settings webhook panel fully present (webhook-url, webhook-kind-toggle, webhook-enabled-toggle, send-test-webhook-btn) and TEST WEBHOOK gracefully shows an error toast (no 500 / no crash), Server-detail OPTIONS tab → VALIDATE button reveals the options-validation-result panel with PASS/err/warn summary chips. Prior iteration-6 COOKIE_SECURE bug is FIXED (server.py:872-879 — _cookie_secure_flag helper now respected on login+setup+refresh). No new bugs found.

minor.issue: In this environment count returns 0 because seeded servers default to adapter_mode='mock' (documented expected behavior). End-to-end SSH path not exercised here; main agent should verify against a real SSH server in production.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1968 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Strongly recommend splitting into auth.py, crypto.py, scheduler.py, bulk_ops.py, options_validator.py, csv_exports.py modules before the next feature batch.

send_webhook (server.py ~309-385) uses urllib for outbound POST — fine for stdlib-only but blocks the event loop; consider httpx.AsyncClient or wrap in asyncio.to_thread for consistency with _ssh_real_exec.

Options validator (_OPT_KEYWORDS / _OPT_TARGETS sets) is hard-coded inside the route handler. Move to a dedicated module + unit tests with a richer corpus (LINGER, REPORTLOG with args, GROUPCASEINSENSITIVE on/off, INCLUDEALL/EXCLUDEALL).
expiry_export + audit_export build CSV in memory with StringIO — fine for current row counts but could exhaust RAM on very large audit logs (TTL=90d). Stream via StreamingResponse for safety.
audit_export ignores any auth dependency — anyone with a valid cookie can pull full audit history regardless of role. Consider gating to require_admin like /settings.

_redact_smtp_for_client returns smtp_password_set but PUT /settings rejects unknown keys via Pydantic ConfigDict default? Verified passing extra smtp_password_set in payload still works because AlertSettings model_config defaults to allow — confirmed test_put_settings_persists_webhook passes.

success_rate.backend: 66/66 (100%) — 21 iteration-7 new + 27 iteration-4 auth + 18 iteration-6 hardening
success_rate.frontend: 6/6 critical flows (100%) — login, dashboard, sync-all & reread-all buttons + toast, expiry CSV download, webhook panel + test webhook toast, options validate

test_credentials: admin@example.com / adminpass123 (verified). Temp engineer user TEST_eng_<uuid> created on the fly for 403 tests then left in DB (idempotent — tests use unique uuid each run).
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed changes. Tests mutate /api/settings (webhook + smtp) and /api/servers/{id}/ssh + /adapter then reset to mock at end of class. Recommend POST /api/seed/reset between runs if a clean baseline is required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-7 features green. Reusable harness: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration7.py uses requests.Session + cookie-jar (no manual JWT handling). Engineer-403 pattern via POST /api/users → re-login. Webhook test must return 200 with ok:false on bad host (NOT 500). CSV endpoints return text/csv + Content-Disposition attachment. Frontend testids confirmed: sync-all-btn, reread-all-btn, export-expiry-csv-btn, webhook-url, webhook-kind-toggle, webhook-enabled-toggle, send-test-webhook-btn, tab-options, validate-options-btn, options-validation-result. Backend URL via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (preview). Code review: server.py size remains the biggest tech-debt item.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration. Iteration-6 COOKIE_SECURE bug verified fixed: _cookie_secure_flag() helper at server.py:872-873 is now used by _set_auth_cookies (line 877) and auth_refresh, so COOKIE_SECURE env is consistently honored across login, setup, and refresh paths.
